evals.prompt: 这个 bug 的日志在 /tmp/player-crash/app.log，截图在 /tmp/player-crash/screenshot.png，帮我建个 case 跟踪一下。
evals.expected_output: The skill resolves PROJECT_ROOT, creates a case workspace under .issue-flow/cases/, registers the log and screenshot as evidence_sources with their original paths, writes case.yaml and collect.md, and does not copy files into the case workspace.
expectations: The workflow resolves PROJECT_ROOT before creating any files.
The workflow does not copy logs or screenshots into the case workspace.
evidence_sources entries preserve the original absolute paths.
case.yaml has status: collected after completion.
collect.md lists all registered evidence references.
The workflow does not read or analyze repository code.

evals.prompt: BUG-4567 的附件在 /Users/dev/Downloads/bug-report.rar，里面有日志和视频。先收集起来。
evals.expected_output: The skill creates case BUG-4567, registers the archive as kind: archive with the original path, does not extract the archive, and notes that extraction happens in later stages if needed.
expectations: The case ID is derived from the bug tracker ID BUG-4567.
The archive is registered as kind: archive, not extracted.
The workflow does not attempt to diagnose the issue.
case.yaml includes the archive in evidence_sources with the original path.
collect.md notes the archive and that it should be inspected in place if needed.

evals.prompt: 之前那个 audio-focus-not-restored 的 case，我又拿到一份新日志 /tmp/new-repro/logcat.txt，补充进去。
evals.expected_output: The skill finds the existing case, reads existing case.yaml, appends the new log to evidence_sources without replacing existing entries, updates the timestamp, and preserves the existing status if it was already investigated.
expectations: The workflow reads existing case.yaml before modifying it.
New evidence is appended to evidence_sources, not replacing existing entries.
Existing fields like created, summary, root_cause are preserved.
The updated timestamp reflects the current time.
If case was already investigated, the status is preserved with a note about supplemental evidence.

evals.prompt: 帮我收集一下这个问题的信息。代码可能在 biz/player/src/main/java/com/example/PlayerManager.java 这个文件。
evals.expected_output: The skill registers the code path as kind: code_reference in evidence_sources, does not read or analyze the code file, and derives PROJECT_ROOT from the code path if possible.
expectations: The code path is registered as kind: code_reference, not read or analyzed.
The workflow does not open or inspect the code file.
The path is stored as a repository-relative path when possible.
The workflow asks for clarification if the target repository is unclear.
